name: Tennant
bio: Archetype: Bullet, Shield. ⌽ Her Insight casts her S2 as an Extra Action at the beginning of battle and when falling below 50% HP. ⌽ Reduces DMG Taken while her Shield from S2 is active. ⌽ Gains [Diamond Bullet] at the beginning of battle and after casting her Ult, which reduces enemy Reality DEF after attacking.
